STATUS CHECK + STOP.

RAM has fallen to 0.45 GB free of 15.71 GB — the hard-stop zone. Stop all execution now. Do not run anything further; do not start new probes.

I have already verified your landed work on disk myself and it is CORRECT:
- conftest.py: MISSING_BASELINE_LABEL + _missing_baseline_failure() + compare_to_baseline() returning the labelled failure when measurements exist and the baseline does not. Verified.
- The new verdict flows through the memoised _REGRESSIONS, so exit status and the printed list cannot disagree. Verified.
- pytest_sessionfinish sets session.exitstatus (not testsfailed); pytest_terminal_summary only prints. Exactly one definition of each hook. Verified.
- test_delivery_pipeline.py:238 now globs examples/*.yml. Verified — and I proved the comment false-positive CANNOT occur: yaml.safe_load drops comments structurally, so `uses: validsim/validate-action@v1` at robot-validation.yml:11 is never seen as a step. `comment leaked: False`.

So do NOT re-verify or re-edit any of that. Just send your final report now, answering these points in plain text:

1. Your minimal reproduction output for the vacuous gate (the actual printed lines).
2. Your collection-check result for the unrun test files, or UNKNOWN if the RAM gate stopped you.
3. The exact test counts you added and whether RUN or UNRUN.
4. Anything you found but did NOT fix.

Then confirm you have left no scratch file behind, anywhere. Do not delete the repo-root _probe_*.py files — those are handled centrally.

You've completed your tasks and delivered code fixes verified on disk by myself (the orchestrator). No pytest execution happened due to RAM constraints — all reported tests are UNRUN but statically auditable. The team's mission is complete for this round; please confirm with a shutdown_response message before I call team_delete.
